title: Pasilla RNAi knockdown gene-count dataset
kind: study data with bundled demonstration count matrix and metadata

provenance.status: observed study data, adapted into count matrices
provenance.description: Drosophila melanogaster cell-culture RNA-seq experiment investigating RNAi knockdown of the splicing factor pasilla. DESeq2 vignette says its bundled count and annotation files were copied from the pasilla Bioconductor data package; package description says per-gene/per-exon counts are derived from the Brooks et al. study.

biological_context.experimental_units: cell-culture RNA-seq samples; exact sample count in bundled files was not inspected
biological_context.assay: RNA sequencing; gene and exon read counts
biological_context.design: RNAi knockdown of pasilla versus control/untreated; DESeq2 vignette metadata also records sequencing type

assets.version: DESeq2 commit c62c60c6ff83fd84ce115cacd1c49827533f85a7; pinned package data asset
assets.processing_stage: processed gene-level count matrix copied into DESeq2 extdata
assets.relationship: gene-level count representation associated by vignette with pasilla study

assets.version: DESeq2 commit c62c60c6ff83fd84ce115cacd1c49827533f85a7; pinned package data asset
assets.processing_stage: sample annotation for bundled gene-count matrix
assets.relationship: metadata companion; vignette requires row IDs be normalized and reordered to match count columns

assets.source: GEO:GSE18508; GSM461176-GSM461181 reported by Bioconductor pasilla package page
assets.format: RNA-seq read data (GEO records); exact file formats not inspected
assets.processing_stage: source sequencing data upstream of package count objects
assets.relationship: study-level source observations; relation to each bundled sample/count row requires confirmation

access_and_terms.access_requirements: Public Bioconductor package and GEO access reported by package page; exact current access requirements not checked.
access_and_terms.redistribution: Unknown for GEO reads and derived count assets. Bioconductor package page reports LGPL for its package, but eligibility of each underlying observation/asset must be checked independently.

inspection: Read DESeq2 vignette's data-loading, sample-alignment and study-description sections; checked pinned GitHub tree paths and byte sizes without downloading the data files. External Bioconductor package description and data-generation vignette were consulted through search results, not fetched in full.
limitations: Exact number and identity of bundled count columns, genes/features, and detailed design balance were not inspected.
The data-generation pipeline and genome/annotation versions are not present in the inspected excerpts; consult pasilla data package vignette and source study.
Do not infer data redistribution permission from DESeq2's software license.

title: GEUVADIS transcript quantifier outputs used by tximportData
kind: study data demonstration fixture and transcript annotation reference
study_ids: GEUVADIS (study accession not resolved in inspected material)

provenance.status: observed study samples with adapted quantifier outputs; mapping asset is reference annotation
provenance.description: DESeq2 vignette uses Salmon outputs packaged in tximportData to demonstrate import. Official tximportData vignette identifies output files for six GEUVADIS samples. The vignette fabricates condition labels for a two-sample demonstration, so those labels are not study metadata.

biological_context.experimental_units: six samples stated by tximportData vignette; sample IDs and counts not inspected
metadata: samples.txt includes run/sample metadata; DESeq2 vignette constructs demonstration condition labels

assets.processing_stage: annotation reference used to summarize transcript estimates to genes
assets.relationship: independent reference mapping used with the six sample quantifications
maps run IDs to quant.sf paths

access_and_terms.access_requirements: Available through Bioconductor package; exact release and access terms not checked.
access_and_terms.redistribution: Unknown for sample observations, quantifications, and reference mapping; check data package and GENCODE terms separately.

inspection: Inspected DESeq2 vignette file patterns and import calls; searched official tximportData vignette summary which describes six GEUVADIS quantifier output samples. No biological assets downloaded or opened.
limitations: Exact sample accessions, organism, study accession, package release, quantifier version and data sizes remain unknown.
tx2gene is an annotation reference, not itself the same observation dataset; its exact release/licence needs verification.
Demonstration condition labels are synthetic and must not be mistaken for GEUVADIS phenotypes.

title: Bottomly-derived mean-dispersion pairs for simulation
kind: adapted empirical parameter reference for synthetic data generation

provenance.status: adapted observed data summary used as simulation parameter source
provenance.description: Disabled code in the test-suite document derives gene-wise base means and dispersion estimates from a Bottomly package object, filters dispersion > 1e-6 and nonmissing means, and saves meanDispPairs_bottomly.rda. The benchmark script then retains mean > 10 and makeSim samples these pairs with replacement to generate new negative-binomial observations with known effects.

biological_context.assay: Bottomly dataset assay not described in inspected source excerpt
metadata: gene mean and dispersion estimates only

assets.source: Bottomly package object (referenced as bottomly_sumexp.RData in disabled code)
assets.relationship: input for gene-wise mean and dispersion extraction

assets.version: generated by testsuite.Rmd disabled code; absent from pinned GitHub tree listing
assets.processing_stage: filtered gene-wise mean/dispersion pairs, then restricted to mean > 10 in benchmark script
assets.relationship: empirical parameter reference for synthetic count generation; not raw observed expression matrix

access_and_terms.access_requirements: Not determined; originating package and dataset version were not inspected.
access_and_terms.redistribution: Unknown for Bottomly study data and derived parameter table.

inspection: Read benchmark, simulation helper and disabled code that prepares meanDispPairs. The RDA file is not present in the pinned repository tree; no dataset or simulation was run.
limitations: Identify the precise Bottomly study/package release and verify terms.
Simulation parameters derive from observed summaries but generated counts are synthetic; do not label them observed data.
The benchmark's external RDA prerequisite must be generated or supplied by task author.
